## Pull Request Summary

### Description
Provide a concise overview of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

### Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test` and `npm run test:coverage`).
- [ ] No extraneous dependencies added without prior discussion.
- [ ] Added unit tests covering new generator logic or CLI flags.
- [ ] If CLI flags or schema specs changed, documentation (`README.md`, `flobase.schema.json`) has been updated.
- [ ] Scope discipline: v0.1 targets are strictly PostgreSQL + OpenAPI 3.1. New targets must be aligned with `ROADMAP.md`.
